The Prophet freed a demon he caught, recalling Solomon's prayer for a unique kingdom; Solomon, not saying 'If Allah will' over seventy women, had only a half child born.
The Prophet likens himself and people to a man whose fire draws moths, and tells how Solomon gave a child two women disputed to the younger, reversing David.
Solomon meant to go round a hundred wives to beget fighters in Allah's cause but forgot to say 'If Allah will', and only one bore a child, half a person.
A wolf took one of two women's sons; David gave the boy to the elder, but Solomon, offering to cut him in two, gave him to the younger, who objected.
